Prenatal Massage in Bellevue, WA

A supportive massage experience with positioning, pressure and focus adapted around your comfort during pregnancy.

Comfort-conscious care

What Is Prenatal Massage?

Prenatal massage adapts massage techniques and positioning for the physical changes of pregnancy. Before treatment, your therapist asks about your stage of pregnancy, comfort and any guidance from your healthcare provider.

Potential benefits

May help ease everyday muscle tension and create restorative time for rest and relaxation.

Who may benefit

Pregnant guests seeking gentle, personalized care may appreciate a session shaped around their changing comfort needs.

What to expect

Your therapist uses supportive positioning and checks in about pressure throughout the appointment.

Prenatal massage in Bellevue

Every pregnancy and every day can feel different. At Fall Health Spa, the session is adjusted around how you feel when you arrive. Prenatal massage is wellness care and is not a substitute for medical care. If you have a high-risk pregnancy, complications or concerns, ask your healthcare provider whether massage is appropriate before booking.

You may also explore a gentle Swedish massage, browse all services, or contact us about insurance massage benefits.

Frequently Asked Questions

How is prenatal massage adapted for pregnancy?

Positioning, bolstering, pressure and focus areas are adjusted for comfort. Your therapist will explain the setup and invite feedback.

When can I receive prenatal massage?

Individual circumstances vary. Contact us before booking and consult your healthcare provider if you have a high-risk pregnancy, complications or any concern about massage.

What should I tell my massage therapist?

Share your stage of pregnancy, comfort needs, sensitive areas and any restrictions or recommendations from your healthcare provider.

Is prenatal massage covered by insurance?

Coverage and benefits vary by individual insurance plan. Please contact us to verify your massage therapy benefits.
